text:
Samir: Quick heads-up — hourly, here's the snapshot for this week's GPU capacity planning. TL;DR: US-WEST is tight, EU-CENTRAL has runway, APAC-SG sees a midweek spike. Please react with :thumbsup: if you agree with the proposed short-term actions.

Alex: US-WEST numbers first: baseline 11,800 GPU-hours/week. Current queued demand suggests +26% on Wed/Thu => ~3,070 extra GPU-hours. We have 6% spare on current pool.

Priya: Cost note: extra ~3k GPU-hours on A100-equivalent => incremental est $31k/week if run on on-demand. If we use reserved burst nodes (spot + preemptable) we can cut to ~$12k but with preempt risk.

Jasmin: Network constraint: west-1 ephemerals hit egress caps at 9am-11am PST last two days. If we add nodes, watch egress quotas on node images and snapshot backups. Might need to throttle snapshot jobs.

InfraBot: [auto] cluster-west-1: PodPendingRate spike 18% at 09:12 PST. Autoscaler triggered 2x scale events in last 2h.

Nina: For immediate relief I propose: 1) temp +4 GPU instances (h100-on-demand) for 36h window around Wed-Thu peak 2) bump node-pool image-cache to 25% 3) disable daily snapshots during the peak window. Anyone object?

Samir: I like that. One tweak: prefer 2x reserved burst + 2x on-demand to reduce cost and lower preempt risk. Keep snapshots off. Priya: can you estimate cost delta for that split?

Priya: Yes — 2x reserved burst (~$3.8k) + 2x on-demand (~$10.2k) for the 36h window => ~ $14k incremental, vs $31k pure on-demand. Savings ~55%.

Alex: Operational notes: will update HPA/pod-requests for transformer jobs to prefer smaller batch sizes during the window to avoid tail latency explosion. Also enabling prefix KV cache for chat workloads reduces token work by ~12%.

Jasmin: We should also schedule a brief net-throttle on non-prod backup jobs 1h before the ramp to avoid concurrent egress spikes. I'll add a cron change for that window.

Nina: Canary plan: route 15% of traffic to eu-central fallback during US-WEST spike. If tail latency crosses 250ms for >2min we failover to eu-central. Can we set that policy in the router by 08:00 PST Wed?

Alex: Yes, I can push the router policy and the canary weights by 07:45 PST Wed. Need ops approval for cross-region cost hit on tokens — Priya?

Priya: Approve for the 36h window with a $20k cap. If we exceed, alerts to finance+infra and we pull the reserved burst first.

Samir: Action items recap: Alex — implement canary routing + HPA tuning. Nina/Jasmin — change snapshot cron + throttle non-prod backups. Priya — monitor cost burn, set alert at $12k. Infra — add 2 reserved burst + 2 on-demand GPUs in west-1 for Wed 00:00 UTC to Thu 12:00 UTC. I'll be on-call Wed AM to coordinate.

Alex: Got it. I'll post a short runbook snippet once router changes are in.

InfraBot: [auto] schedule: reserved-burst-west-1 queued for provisioning at 2023-11-08T00:30:00Z.

Samir: Thanks everyone. If anything changes ping me in-thread. :rocket:
